The Blend Experience

More than a salon —
a Brazilian ritual.

Stepping into Blend is unlike any other salon visit. We greet you with espresso served in fine porcelain, sparkling water, and the warmth of Brazilian hospitality — because beauty is about how you feel from the moment you arrive.

  • Welcome ritual: espresso & sparkling water on arrival
  • Brazilian-trained stylists with 10+ years of experience
  • Premium professional products from Kérastase
  • Personalized consultation before every service
  • Bilingual service — English & Portuguese

Premium Care

Professional Products,
Real Results

At Blend Hair Boutique in Plantation, Florida, we work exclusively with professional-grade products and color lines — because your hair deserves nothing less.

Professional-Grade Color — We use professional color lines selected for vibrancy, lasting power, and hair health — the same products trusted by top salons across South Florida.

Smoothing Treatments — Our Brazilian blowout and keratin formulas are carefully chosen for safety, longevity, and results that stand up to Florida's humidity.

Home-Care Guidance — Every client leaves with a personalized routine to protect and maintain their results between visits to our Plantation boutique.

Luxury Products Available — We carry a curated selection of professional-grade products so you can extend the life of your services at home.
